question: How does the heart become the place where the visible world is seen as one's own body?
premises: The heart is the place of consciousness-light.
The visible world is seen as own limb.
The yogi pervades all states in harmony.
inference: Heart-centered consciousness-light lets the yogi see the visible world as his own body without subject-object division.
uncertainties: Some compounds are dense and glossed as fused units.
Technical terms are rendered in plain English.
plain_english: In the heart, consciousness-light makes the visible world appear as one's own body, and the yogi pervades all states in supreme harmony.
